answer: Northwind Traders grew revenue 12% in fiscal 2023, driven by its logistics division. Headcount rose from 480 to 512 employees. The board approved $2,000,000 for warehouse automation. Priya Chandra was named Chief Financial Officer. The company plans to expand into three new international markets next year.
